text:
maia: Heads-up — planning a targeted rollout tomorrow 10:00 PT for a small API response-envelope change. Adds a top-level `meta` object (backwards-compatible for most clients) but need deploy owner + smoke + client comms. Can someone own?

jon: I can own deploy + smoke. Will gate on canary first then promote. @ryan can you be on rollback standby?

ryan: Happy to. Quick Q: how do we rollback? Is there a single tag + route flip?

maia: Yes — rollback is just reverting to previous route and tag. I'll push the rollback branch name to the runbook before deploy.

sarah.k: Code review done, LGTM. Left one note about generated clients that do strict schema validation — adding a feature flag to opt-in to `strict` parsing in the SDK. Small test added.

jon: Notes for smoke plan (short):
1) health /status check (200, schema v2 ok)
2) token exchange + auth header check
3) basic generation + response contains `meta`
4) embeddings endpoint sanity
5) long-prompt streaming (check p95 latency)
6) 50 RPS load run against canary for 2m

alisha: I'll send client comms: short note to integrations@, linking migration guide and example diff. Draft: "Minor response shape change: new top-level meta field. No client changes required for most users; see guide if you use generated strict parsers." Want to review before send.

maia: Draft looks good. Add brief rollback instructions in the email so SDK consumers know to pin to legacy route if they hit issues.

ryan: Alerting we should watch during rollout: `errors.5xx_ratio > 1%` and `api.p95 > 300ms` for more than 2 consecutive minutes. I'll add temporary on-call rules to watch those.

jon: Deploy runbook snippets I'll use:
```
# rollback tag
git checkout -b release/rollback-2039876543
git reset --hard origin/release/v1.24.3
git push origin release/rollback-2039876543
# route flip
infractl route set --service api --target release/v1.24.3
```

devops-bot: pipeline-ci: canary build passed ✅ — canary deploy started to 5% (job id: ci-2039876543-canary)

jon: Canary smoke started at 10:04 PT. Running the checklist.

devops-bot: canary health checks: all green 
- /status: 200
- token exchange: OK
- generation sanity: OK
- p95 latency: 210ms

ryan: Observability: no spike in 5xx. Watching logs for schema errors from clients generated with strict mode.

jon: Promoting to 50% at 10:07 PT.

devops-bot: canary promote: 50% -> 100% queued (job ci-2039876543-promote)

jon: Promoted to 100% at 10:12 PT. Quick pass looks clean — no increase in errors, latency stable. :tada:

alisha: Sending comms to integrations@ now, will paste thread link.

maia: Thanks everyone. I'll update the rollout doc with final notes and the rollback tag: `release/rollback-2039876543`. If anything odd appears, ping here and we'll coordinate rollback.

jon: All clear from my side. Closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
